definitions.gloss: closing time; store closing for the day
definitions.explanation: The time when a store or restaurant closes for business each day.

definitions.gloss: permanent closure; going out of business
definitions.explanation: The permanent shutting down of a business.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でお⟦{急|いそ}ぎ→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Closing time is approaching, so please hurry.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}んで→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I rushed in to shop just before closing time.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{閉店|へいてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: That store is apparently closing down next month.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧になっていた。
examples.english: Everything was half off at the closing sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和菓子屋|わがしや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{後継者|こうけいしゃ}→後継者：12592_koukeisha⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{閉店|へいてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The long-established Japanese confectionery shop is closing due to lack of a successor.

notes:
{閉店|へいてん} has two distinct meanings: daily closing (sense 1) and permanent closure (sense 2). Context usually makes the meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉店|へいてん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: closing time (daily)
- {閉店|へいてん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: going-out-of-business sale (permanent)
- {閉店|へいてん}⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧: just before closing
- {閉店|へいてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to close
- {閉店|へいてん}ガラガラ: the sound of shutters closing (onomatopoeic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧: opening (opposite)
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: end of business hours (formal)
- ⟦{廃業|はいぎょう}→廃業：20645_haigyou⟧: going out of business (formal, permanent)

For permanent closure, {閉店|へいてん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ is a familiar sight — stores offer deep discounts to clear remaining inventory before shutting down.
